cond_0001.intro: The XR People Generation team works in collaboration with Reality Labs Research partners in order to deliver the future of communication - photorealistic telepresence via Codec Avatars. Our aspiration is to connect people separated by distance as if they were in the same room together. We achieve this by researching, developing and productionizing state-of-the-art methods in cross sections of computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning for human understanding and telepresence. These include (semi-) supervised deep learning, generative adversarial learning, active learning, neural rendering, depth sensing, 3D reconstruction, character animation and rendering.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Building evaluation and analysis systems and tooling to better understand the performance of our computer vision machine learning models
Conduct applied research in computer vision and machine learning (person semantic understanding, novel view synthesis, non-rigid tracking, etc.)
Advance the state of AI for your problem, including setting and executing against roadmaps for 6-month plus timeframes
Define methodology and benchmarks to evaluate different approaches
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience in a research engineering capacity: defining evaluation metrics, building evaluation systems, running basic ML model experimentation
Research background in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, or related fields
3+ Years of experience in developing and debugging in Python, C/C++, C#, or similar programming language
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Python
Experience working and communicating cross functionally in a team environment

The XR People Generation team works in collaboration with [Company name masked] Research partners in order to deliver the future of communication - photorealistic telepresence via Codec Avatars. Our aspiration is to connect people separated by distance as if they were in the same room together. We work together to research, develop, and productionize state-of-the-art methods in cross sections of computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning for human understanding and telepresence. These include (semi-) supervised deep learning, generative adversarial learning, active learning, neural rendering, depth sensing, 3D reconstruction, character animation and rendering.
You will be working on a priority project alongside a talented and supportive team. There are weekly team meetings and one-on-ones, where you will coordinate with other teams.

Collaborate with the team to build evaluation and analysis systems and tooling to better understand the performance of our computer vision machine learning models
Work alongside colleagues on applied research in computer vision and machine learning (person semantic understanding, novel view synthesis, non-rigid tracking, etc.)
Contribute to advancing the state of AI for your problem area, including coordinating with the team to set and execute against roadmaps for 6-month plus timeframes
Work with others to define methodology and benchmarks to evaluate different approaches

Research background in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, or related fields

Experience working with Python

We achieve this by researching, developing and productionizing state-of-the-art methods in cross sections of computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning for human understanding and telepresence. These include (semi-) supervised deep learning, generative adversarial learning, active learning, neural rendering, depth sensing, 3D reconstruction, character animation and rendering.
cond_0424.responsibilities:
Building evaluation and analysis systems and tooling to better understand the performance of our computer vision machine learning models
Conduct applied research in computer vision and machine learning (person semantic understanding, novel view synthesis, non-rigid tracking, etc.)
Advance the state of AI for your problem, including setting and executing against roadmaps for 6-month plus timeframes
Define methodology and benchmarks to evaluate different approaches
cond_0424.requirements:
Experience in a research engineering capacity: defining evaluation metrics, building evaluation systems, running basic ML model experimentation
Research background in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, or related fields
3+ Years of experience in developing and debugging in Python, C/C++, C#, or similar programming language
Experience working with Python
Experience working and communicating cross functionally in a team environment
cond_0424.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

cond_0488.intro:
The XR People Generation team works in collaboration with Reality Labs Research partners in order to deliver the future of communication - photorealistic telepresence via Codec Avatars. Our aspiration is to connect people separated by distance as if they were in the same room together. We achieve this by researching, developing and productionizing state-of-the-art methods in cross sections of computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning for human understanding and telepresence. These include (semi-) supervised deep learning, generative adversarial learning, active learning, neural rendering, depth sensing, 3D reconstruction, character animation and rendering.
The ideal candidate will be working on a priority project with a talented and supportive team. There are weekly team meetings and one-on-ones, where this individual will work alongside other teams.
cond_0488.responsibilities:
Building evaluation and analysis systems and tooling to better understand the performance of our computer vision machine learning models
Conduct applied research in computer vision and machine learning (person semantic understanding, novel view synthesis, non-rigid tracking, etc.)
Advance the state of AI for your problem, including setting and executing against roadmaps for 6-month plus timeframes
Define methodology and benchmarks to evaluate different approaches
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven track record in a research engineering capacity: defining evaluation metrics, building evaluation systems, running ML model experimentation
Substantial research background in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, or related fields
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise developing and debugging in Python, C/C++, C#, or similar programming language
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of Python in a professional or research setting
Strong command of cross-functional collaboration and communication within a team environment

These include (semi-) supervised deep learning, generative adversarial learning, active learning, neural rendering, depth sensing, 3D reconstruction, character animation, and rendering.
cond_0646.responsibilities:
Building evaluation and analysis systems and tooling to better understand the performance of our computer vision machine learning models
Conduct applied research in computer vision and machine learning (person semantic understanding, novel view synthesis, non-rigid tracking, etc.)
Advance the state of AI for your problem, including defining and executing against roadmaps for 6-month plus timeframes
Define methodology and benchmarks to evaluate different approaches
cond_0646.requirements:
Experience in a research engineering capacity: defining evaluation metrics, building evaluation systems, running basic ML model experimentation
Research background in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, or related fields
3+ Years of experience in developing and debugging in Python, C/C++, C#, or similar programming language
Experience working with Python
Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams to complete project deliverables
